name: The Battlefords Provincial Park - Core Area Campgrounds
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19, core area only (Centre, North, Spruce Meadow): every one of the 213 sites' SKPP detail pages reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z17 (0.72 m/px) with all 213 SKPP GIS site points plotted: Centre's lakeward sites (225, 227, 253-261) lie about 200-300 m from Jackfish Lake's open water, behind the day-use beach, its parking lots, the Lakeview group camp and shoreline woods; Spruce Meadow (701-720) farther back across the park road and lots; North east of the main road, inland. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290515, read 2026-11-19 (paging table + every site's detail page): Center 79 (53 Nightly Electric 15/30 A, 26 Nightly Non-Electric) + North 114 (59 Nightly Electric + 3 Accessible Nightly Electric, 52 Seasonal Electric) + Spruce Meadow 20 Nightly Non-Electric = 213 site-specific sites, 161 by the night (115 electric); maximum equipment 18-50 ft, 152 nightly sites take a 19-25 ft unit. South (121) is now its own entry. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campgrounds near the north-east shore of Jackfish Lake, set back in aspen woods behind the day-use beach and its parking lots: Centre by the beach, Spruce Meadow beside it, North across the main road. South campground, about 1.8 km down the shore on its own road, has its own entry. 52 North sites are seasonal. --Claude

curation_note: Split 2026-11-19: this id kept the core area (Centre, North, Spruce Meadow; 213 sites, pin unchanged on Centre's sites); South campground (sites 301-421, 121 nightly electric) became a new entry, measured 1.88 km centroid to centroid (nearest sites 1.32 km apart) on its own road and gate.
